### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **49** documentable anchor(s).

**21** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **172** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `116b722875f14013841962ec87358d0eb87b8fbd` — the merge of head `533a4f9328f0800da22536a90c5b07d7b256a768` into base `2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 116b722875f14013841962ec87358d0eb87b8fbd && git checkout 116b722875f14013841962ec87358d0eb87b8fbd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0 533a4f9328f0800da22536a90c5b07d7b256a768 && git checkout -B drift-repro 2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0 && git merge --no-ff 533a4f9328f0800da22536a90c5b07d7b256a768

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 2f80f2897a4c484c9ff445d268ab83e1ce16a6d0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `55a9c1f24a8cde12cb594ed2d3b6d77eb4248966`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts, protocol-meta-item-reads.ts, protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts, protocol-meta-list-reads.ts, protocol-registry-hydration.ts, protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts; packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts, protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts, protocol-registry-shadow.test.ts; packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts. Read, not reviewed: protocol-lock-state.ts, protocol-package-bindings.ts, protocol-metadata-service-read.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts, packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts, ADR-0146.

Inputs: card #32568 with all eight comments (ruling 6817768147, comment 6815814974), the PR body, its 13 files, the net diff, and the head's check-runs: 58 success, the rest skipped, none failed (Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Spec property liveness all success).

### ① Derived judgments

Each FROM → TO row read against the tree, not the body:

- Row 1, right. The strict draft read and the preview run the draft through `exactQualifierItem`; the layered `draft` layer does the same; all three catch blocks rethrow a package-scoped refusal before the store-outage rule.
- Row 2, right. The scoped list drops a package-less stand-in draft that `packageLessRowWithheld` or `declinesPackageLessRowAt` names.
- Row 3, right. Strict draft falls to `noPendingDraftError`, the preview falls through to the active read, the layered layer is `null`.
- Row 4, right. `soleHolderOf` answers `null` with two holders, so no envelope lookup runs; a declined sealed row returns before registration.
- Rows 5 and 6, right in the answer. `declinedCopyReplaced` runs before `exactQualifierItem` on the active exit; the layered overlay is nulled before the D4 judge. Two notes: (a) the class is wider than the table says: the #31699 pin loop moved from `agent`, `skill`, `app`, `dashboard` to `dashboard`, `report`, so `agent`, `skill` and `app` go 409 → 200 too; (b) row 6 also moves with one holder (row reported → `overlay: null`), pinned in the test title and stated in the changeset, absent from the table.
- Row 7, right at the exact address in every state. For the bare read it holds only where the hydrator or the heal walk has run (see S2).
- Rows 8, 9, 10, right. Location 2's five types are pinned; the two registry-direct pins moved in place with the old answer named.
- Row 11, a legitimate consequence, not a declared capability taken away. Reasons, from the tree: (1) ruling rule 1 leaves no read at a holder's exact address that may serve a sealed type's package-less row, and `routeOwnerOfRefusedRead` reads exactly those addresses; (2) main's answer on `lead` existed only because the first holder's address served an item that is not that holder's, which by reading also left that holder without its own route (its address answered the environment item, unpinned either way); (3) the route's own contract says the environment's item has no address of its own; (4) seat ruling B pinned main's answers as a known disagreement awaiting the owner seat, not as a capability; (5) the new answer fails closed: `admitResolvedAction` refuses an undeclared action, never runs it ungated. What is lost is real and narrow (an environment action on an object neither of two holders binds cannot be run through the bare route until the execution face reads `_env`); it is declared in the body and the changeset.
- Public surface: `src/index.ts` is not in the diff; the three new helpers stay module-internal. Right.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor with the BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: matches the PR body and the claim. `@objectstack/spec` patch for the entry alone, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`: differs from the PR body by design (it registers, it narrows nothing). Check Changeset is success on this head, so the gate accepts the pair. `adr-0087: registered` names the entry id the file carries.
- The objectql and runtime changes are tests only and publish nothing. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6826235701: `open_questions` empty, `security_findings` none. Seven deviations, each explained; the three out-of-surface files are covered by claim amendment 6825431885.
- Escalated, not answered here: rows 5 and 6 carry no arm for `action` (409 → 200). Ruling 6817768147 orders the move and asks for "each with its arm"; the PR answers "none" with the ruling's own sentence. The epic red-line read owed before ACCEPT confirms or corrects that arm.
- Escalated: the dev's out-of-scope finding (the bare route does not read `_env`) is "noted, not filed". Row 11 rests on that follow-up; it needs a card or a link to the owner seat's before ACCEPT.
- The history, audit and diff doors are declared unswept, with the reason (event ledger by type and name, no item at an exact address). Accepted as declared.
- The PR is authored by objectstack-fleet[bot] through the relay, signed by the seat; no boundary breach read.

### ④ Design judgment

**M1, must-fix: the entry and the changeset prescribe a remedy that most of the named types do not have.** The hits file's `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` for class (2) say: author the change as a declared override in the holder's paired `.custom` package (ADR-0146), and `?package=ID` then answers the override. It names `action, agent, page, hook, job, queue, sharing_rule, assignment_rule and the like`. On `main`, `declinesStoredRow` admits a declared override row for a closed list only: `flow`, `action`, and `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book`, `mapping` (`SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES`). ADR-0146 says the same: "No code-only type (`hook`, `job`, `api`, `agent`, ...) gains an override channel"; customization of those "is a new version of the package". So for six of the eight types the entry names, the override row is itself declined and the acceptance criterion cannot be met. The changeset's second "The fix" bullet repeats it. Fix: split class (2) by whether the type has a declared override channel; for the rest, prescribe what the governing text gives (delete the row; the change ships in a package version, or lives under a name no package holds). The same split should say what an environment action of row 11's shape owes, since it overrides neither holder.

**S1, should-fix: the layered read's code layer is not judged as the plain read now judges it.** `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` keeps `exactQualifierItem(code)` alone; the plain exit now runs `declinedCopyReplaced` first. The #32407 comment there states the contract: the code layer is "what the plain read's own code step answers there, judged as it judges it". When `lookupArtifactItem` finds the holder's artifact the layers agree, which is every pinned state. A package-less copy answered by the `metadata` service (a type the service keys by name alone, or a slotted type where the package has no service slot) reaches `code` unjudged: served as the holder's code and effective layer with one holder or an unjudged type, 409 for `action` with two. By reading, not measured; no pin covers a service answer on either read. Run the code layer through `declinedCopyReplaced`, or pin the state.

**S2, should-fix: row 7's bare-read half is pinned for two of four states.** A copy registered before the package arrived stays in the bare slot until the next hydration heals it. Exact reads are safe (`declinedCopyReplaced`); the bare read of a one-holder name still answers the copy (`getItem`, or the bare `action` judge's environment-first rule), then the holder's own after a list read. Outside the ruling's exact-address rule, so not a FAIL; pin it or scope row 7's sentence.

**S3, should-fix:** name `agent`, `skill`, `app` in row 5 and the one-holder move in row 6 (see ①).

Tried and held: both registration orders (no lookup names no package for a scoped type); two holders arriving after a one-holder hydration (the stored row answers the exact read first, 409); a disabled holder (`readMetaItemFace` still withholds its item); pair addresses with two bases (refused naming both); drafts bound to another package (not the address's, no draft there).

Nits: `permission` follows the D4 arm on the new draft exits and is in neither prose class; the runtime test's describe docblock still says the route takes the package-less declaration; `loaded++` counts a row the boot load declined; `routeTo('account')` (the first holder's own route, which row 11 restores) is unpinned.

Reviewed-by: `session_01L6bhgVaKJ9TPfXPRhdqx3e`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b7523cbb589114a963db35ace1c6bcbd84c1d9d2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class.ts + .changeset/32568-package-less-row-sealed-and-draft-exits.md, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts, packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts, and the merge's one three-way file packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts. Read, not reviewed: the main side of the merge (packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts, metadata-manager.ts, protocol-heal-binding.ts), protocol-package-bindings.ts, ADR-0146.

Delta record: `55a9c1f24` to this head, after the FAIL on `55a9c1f24` (comment 6826558393). It is the fix commits `430dfbe47` and `301fce8df`, then the merge of `main` (`af90f307c`). Everything the first record judged right and this delta does not touch stands as judged there.

Inputs: card #32568 with report 6828897073, the PR body as now on the PR (r3), the compare `55a9c1f24...301fce8df` (5 files, +66 −14), the compare of `301fce8df` with `main`, the three trees, and the check-runs on both heads.

Check-runs. On the dev head `301fce8df`: 56 success, 11 skipped, none failed. On this head, when read: 12 success, 12 skipped, 15 in progress, one superseded PR-body guards run cancelled (its rerun is success). Pending: Build Core, Build UI Deps, Plan Test Core shards, Plan Test UI shards, Live E2E UI, Type Check (workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger), Lint (ESLint, repo and tooling gates, docs and code guards, CI release and engine gates, scoped query-options erasure, scoped slot lookup and corpus). The Test Core and Test UI shards had not started. This verdict is on the contract and the design; the gate verdicts on this head are still owed and the seat reads them before ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- Row 5b (new), right. `agent`, `skill`, `app` are named: two holders 409 → each holder's own, one holder the item → the holder's own. Matches the moved #31699 pins.
- Row 6 (rewritten), right. The one-holder move (row reported → `overlay: null`) is now in the table.
- Row 11 (rewritten), right. It now says the first holder's own route answered no declaration on main, and links #32751 (open) for the execution face.
- Row 12 (new), right. The layered `code` layer with a package-less `metadata` service copy: one holder the copy → the holder's own; two holders `action` 409 or `queue` the copy → the holder's own. The tree does this: `getMetaItemLayered` runs `declinedCopyReplaced` before `exactQualifierItem` on `code`, with `wantedMember`, as the plain exit does.
- Public surface: `src/index.ts` is still not in the diff. The layered host's `Pick` gains `isStoredEntryOfDeclinedName`, a module-internal type. Right.
- The merge moves no answer of this PR (see ④).

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged and still right: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, same in the PR body and the changeset; `@objectstack/spec` patch for the entry, `no` and `none` by design. Row 12 adds a served-where-it-served-otherwise move under the same narrowing arm; no level moves.
- The fix adds tests, prose and one judged call; nothing new publishes. Check Changeset was success on `301fce8df` and on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The first record's two escalations: (a) the `_env` route follow-up is filed as #32751, open, and linked from row 11, the changeset and the runtime test: answered. (b) the arm for the 409 → 200 rows (5, 5b, 6, 12 for `action` with two holders) is still "none" with the ruling's sentence; it stays the epic red-line read's to confirm before ACCEPT.
- S2 is filed as #32752, open, and named in the body's acceptance notes with row 7's bare half scoped to the hydrated states. Accepted as a follow-up: it sits outside the ruling's exact-address rule.
- The merge is by objectstack-fleet[bot] through the relay's update-branch; the commit's committer is GitHub and its signature verifies.

### ④ Design judgment

**M1, closed.** The entry splits class (2) by override channel. (2a) names `flow`, `action`, `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book`, `mapping`: exactly the set `declinesStoredRow` admits a declared override row for on `main` (`SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` plus `flow` and `action`), with ADR-0146 D9's conditions named for the two it conditions. (2b) gives the rest what ADR-0146 gives them: delete the row, ship the change in a new version of the holding package, or keep it under a name no package ships; the row 11 environment action is named there. The acceptance criteria follow the split and can be met for every named type. The changeset's fix bullets say the same and quote ADR-0146.

**S1, closed.** The layered code layer is judged as the plain read judges it. Four pins (`action` and `queue`, one holder and two) read a service answering a package-less copy on both reads and assert `code`, `overlay` and `effective`, and that the service was read. Tried against it: an artifact found for the holder is returned unchanged (stamped, so not a copy); a bare read has no exact address and is untouched; two bases of a pair are refused naming both; an address with no registry holder answers `code: null`, as the plain read answers nothing.

**The merge, clean.** `b7523cbb` has parents `301fce8df` and `af90f307c`. Read from the three trees: no path is dropped, and every file equals one parent except `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`. There, main's side is three comment hunks in `restoreArtifactRegistryView` (the cluster signal's package, #32739), far from the hydrator hunks, and the PR's net diff of the file is still +45 −4. The other twelve PR files are byte-identical to the dev head. Main brought 17 commits. Those near the narrowing: #32687 (the `metadata` service keeps every locale and every package's item; `package-slotted-store.ts`, `metadata-manager.ts`), #32739 (the heal's package on a cluster signal) and the history-by-package fix. None changes `declinesStoredRow`, the sealed or overlay type sets, `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`, `exactQualifierItem`, or the five-argument `restoreArtifactRegistryView` the hydrator calls. #32687 changes what the service can answer at an address, which is the state S1's fix now covers on both reads whatever the service returns. The Type Check and Test Core runs on this head are the measurement of that reading and are pending.

Nits (no effect on the contract): (2a) lists `flow`, which this change's own predicate excludes (`declinesPackageLessRowAt` is not a flow's rule), so no flow row moves here; the override-channel sentence sits in `surface` where `replacement` already carries it; the S1 pins stamp the copy `''`, an unstamped copy takes the same branch unpinned; `routeTo('account')` is still unpinned (it belongs with #32751).

No must-fix and no should-fix open on this delta.

## Epic red-line delta read · 2026-11-12T16:23Z

Head-sha: `b7523cbb589114a963db35ace1c6bcbd84c1d9d2`. Contract delta PASS: 6829031725. Read-only.
Verdict: **HOLD on declaration text only.** The code holds red lines 1–3, so no code round is needed.

**Arm for rows 5, 5b, 6 and 12** (`action`, two holders, 409 → 200 the holder's own item): "none" is not acceptable here.
- Rule: `execution-duties.md`, Clause-② lines. Lifting a refusal is "no" only when published contract text already denies that refusal and the "no" cites that text. A ruling guard is deliberate, and removing one is "yes".
- This 409 is a ruling guard. #32566 added it for `action` on epic ruling 6761802819, declared it as a narrowing, and pinned it.
- The sentence the PR cites comes from ruling comment 6817768147, not from an ADR. ADR-0150 D4 draws no type-class split.
- Precedent: #32718 declared "one over-refusal lifted" as `yes (widening)`, and #32513 marks refused → admitted rows "widening". No PR in this epic uses "none" for refused → served.
- These 409s are unreleased (last tag 18.3.0). That mitigates the impact, but the epic declares against main, so the arm does not change.

**Text change** (PR body and `.changeset/32568-package-less-row-sealed-and-draft-exits.md`):
1. Change the declaration line to: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` — reads that served now refuse (as now); beside them one widening: a sealed type's package-less registry or service copy at a holder's exact address and its layered read, `action` with two holders, 409 → 200 the holder's own item (epic ruling 6817768147).
2. Delete "drop a refusal the governing text denies, so they are no widening" from the changeset.
3. In rows 5, 5b, 6 and 12, replace "none for action …" with "widening for action with two holders".
4. Replace the paragraph "Why rows 5 and 6 carry no widening arm" with one sentence naming ruling 6817768147 as the authority for the widening.
